feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 5 (±0.06 m outer, ±0.03 m inner, 12 mm footprints, y 0.04 m, 12 cm track) scored 151.91, the best so far, and removed s-bend and slalom line losses (0.0 per run, from 0.9 to 1.0). Every s-bend and slalom trial still ended off track at max_error about 0.061 m, so the failure is now edge drift on the line, not tape loss. Oval oscillation was 0.327 and oval progress 0.71. Iteration 2 at ±0.05 m with 12 mm footprints gave oval oscillation 0.27, so the wider span and the footprint both affect jitter. The controller was held at the iteration 5 gains, so no compensation was needed beyond that. For this candidate, the outcome is not yet known. If the next race shows s-bend and slalom losses still at 0 and max_error still about 0.061 m, the sensor layout is the limit at the edge: change the inner sensors to x = ±0.04 m at sensor_size 0.016 m, since the remaining failure is at the edge, not in the loss logic. If oval oscillation rises above 0.33 or oval progress falls below 0.5, the 16 mm footprint is blurring the centroid, so revert sensor_size to 0.012 m and keep the ±0.06 m span. If s-bend or slalom losses return above 0 at this footprint, the larger footprint is pulling the signal, so revert to 0.012 m. Do not retry the other levers: iteration 3 (wheel_track 0.10 m) cut oval progress from 0.51 to 0.14, and iteration 4 (y 0.06 m) cut oval progress to 0.20 while leaving slalom losses at 1.0.
